name: Mr.Noodles
ingredients_raw: Noodles: Wheat Flour, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein Oil), Iodised Salt, Potassium Chloride, Texturizer (INS 451), Acidity Regulators [INS 500(i), INS 501(i)], Thickener (INS 466), Permitted Food Colour (INS 101). Seasoning Powder: Salt, Sugar, Flavour Enhancers (INS 621, INS 635), Spices & Herbs (Coriander, Garlic, White Pepper, Turmeric, Cumin, Chilli, Cardamom, Aniseed, Cloves, Nutmeg, Ginger), Hydrolysed Soya Protein, Soya bean, Maltodextrin, Maize Starch, Yeast Extract, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein Oil), Permitted Food Colours (INS 100, INS 101, INS 105d, INS 150a, INS 160c) and artificial flavouring substances (Masala).
